project.name: East Cairnbeg
project.boundarySource: Mapped named-place location with a conservative editorial study buffer
project.researchNotes: Full sequential audit. Local HES checks found no listed buildings or scheduled monuments and retained all three NRHE records. The prehistoric palisaded enclosure is visible as a broadly dated heat pin; two period-unassigned records remain map-hidden. No qualifying See, café-led Eat, named trail, picnic place, public parking or public toilet was verified inside the strict boundary. Nearby Fettercairn and Laurencekirk offers are not borrowed.
